title: The Latest: Why President Trump Changed His Tone on the Coronavirus

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: now has more than 4,500 reported coronavirus cases, but the actual total could be much higher.
sentences.zh: 目前的冠状病毒确诊病例报告已超过4500例，但实际总数可能远高于此。

sentences.en: At least 90 people have died.
sentences.zh: 已有至少90人死亡。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: response to the deadly virus lags behind other developed countries.
sentences.zh: 对这种致命病毒的反应落后于其他发达国家。

sentences.en: That is what the experts are saying.
sentences.zh: 专家们正是这么说的。

sentences.en: Life outside the home or apartment has virtually shut down.
sentences.zh: 家门或公寓外面的生活几乎完全停摆。

sentences.en: Schools and businesses are closed, and the social fabric has been badly frayed.
sentences.zh: 学校和企业纷纷关闭，社会结构严重撕裂。

sentences.en: There are still worries, based on the experience of other countries like Italy, which has effectively been on a total lockdown for a week, that it might not be enough.
sentences.zh: 根据其他国家（例如已经全面封锁一周的意大利）的经验，人们仍然担心这些措施可能还不够。

sentences.en: I'm Sherry Fink.
sentences.zh: 我是雪莉·芬克。

sentences.en: I'm a correspondent at The New York Times in the Investigations Unit.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》调查部的记者。

sentences.en: I often report about health care, and I've been covering the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 我经常报道医疗保健相关新闻，也一直在追踪报道冠状病毒。

sentences.en: And in recent weeks, there has been a lot of focus on how President Trump communicates about this outbreak and the level of risk that it poses for the United States.
sentences.zh: 在最近几周里，人们高度关注特朗普总统如何就这场疫情进行沟通，以及它对美国构成的风险水平。

sentences.en: It's going to disappear.
sentences.zh: 它会消失的。

sentences.en: One day, it's like a miracle.
sentences.zh: 总有一天，就像奇迹一样。

sentences.en: It will disappear.
sentences.zh: 它会消失的。

sentences.en: And from our shores, you know, it could get worse before it gets better.
sentences.zh: 从我们的海岸来看，你知道，情况可能会在好转之前先恶化。

sentences.en: It could maybe go away.
sentences.zh: 它也许会消失。

sentences.en: We'll see what happens.
sentences.zh: 我们拭目以待。

sentences.en: Nobody really knows.
sentences.zh: 谁也说不准。

sentences.en: The president's tone started to change probably in the last week or so, but it really seemed to change on Monday.
sentences.zh: 总统的语气大概在大约一周前开始发生变化，但真正让人感觉大变是在周一。

sentences.en: I want to thank everybody for being here today.
sentences.zh: 我想感谢大家今天出席。

sentences.en: There was this press conference.
sentences.zh: 当时召开了这样一场新闻发布会。

sentences.en: The president got on a podium with the members of the vice president's coronavirus task force around him.
sentences.zh: 总统走上讲台，副总统的冠状病毒工作组的成员们环绕在他身旁。

sentences.en: This afternoon, we're announcing new guidelines for every American to follow over the next 15 days as we combat the virus.
sentences.zh: 今天下午，我们宣布了新的准则，供所有美国人在未来15天内遵循，以便我们共同抗击病毒。

sentences.en: Each and every one of us has a critical role to play.
sentences.zh: 我们每一个人都肩负着至关重要的作用。

sentences.en: And he announced that there would be a 15-day period where Americans should observe some important new precautions to try to slow the virus.
sentences.zh: 他宣布将有一个为期15天的时期，在此期间美国人应遵守一些重要的全新防范措施，以试图减缓病毒传播。

sentences.en: Therefore, my administration is recommending that all Americans, including the young and healthy, work to engage in schooling from home when possible,
sentences.zh: 因此，我的政府建议所有美国人，包括年轻人和健康人群，尽可能在家上学和办公，

sentences.en: avoid gathering in groups of more than 10 people, avoid discretionary travel, and avoid eating and drinking at bars, restaurants, and public food courts.
sentences.zh: 避免聚集在10人以上的群体中，避免非必要的旅行，并避免在酒吧、餐厅和公共美食广场饮食。

sentences.en: This really struck a lot of people as a real change in tone and content.
sentences.zh: 这确实让许多人感到语气和内容都发生了真正的变化。

sentences.en: I think that what we do, and I've spoken actually with my son, he says, how bad is this?
sentences.zh: 我想我们所做的，而且我其实和我的儿子沟通过，他说，这有多严重？

sentences.en: It's bad.
sentences.zh: 情况很严重。

sentences.en: It's bad.
sentences.zh: 情况很严重。

sentences.en: But we're going to be hopefully a best case, not a worst case.
sentences.zh: 但我们希望这会是最好的情况，而不是最坏的情况。

sentences.en: And that's what we're working for.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们正在努力的方向。

sentences.en: And so the latest is that we now know a big part of what may have led to that change in tone and to the new recommendations.
sentences.zh: 所以最新的消息是，我们现在知道了导致这种语气转变以及新建议的很大一部分原因。

sentences.en: It was a new report out of London by disease modelers, people who study how epidemics spread, that was shared with the White House.
sentences.zh: 那是伦敦的疾病建模专家（研究流行病如何传播的人）发布的一份新报告，该报告已被分享给白宫。

sentences.en: And it showed that if nothing was done by the government and regular citizens to stop the transmission of the virus,
sentences.zh: 报告显示，如果政府和普通公民不采取任何行动来阻止病毒传播，

sentences.en: that in fact there could be 2.2 million deaths in the United States.
sentences.zh: 那么事实上美国可能会有220万人死亡。

sentences.en: And what they said to combat that, to stop this just almost unimaginable death toll from a new virus, 2.2 million, they said that two types of interventions would be needed,
sentences.zh: 为了抗击疫情，为了阻止一种新病毒带来几乎难以想象的220万死亡人数，他们表示需要采取两种类型的干预措施，

sentences.en: two types of steps.
sentences.zh: 也就是两类步骤。

sentences.en: One set of steps is sort of the basic public health steps.
sentences.zh: 第一组步骤算是基本的公共卫生步骤。

sentences.en: You test for people who might have the virus.
sentences.zh: 对可能感染病毒的人进行检测。

sentences.en: You tell them to stay home.
sentences.zh: 告诉他们待在家里。

sentences.en: You isolate them or they go into the hospital.
sentences.zh: 将他们隔离或者让他们去医院。

sentences.en: All of their close contacts stay away from everybody else for 14 days.
sentences.zh: 他们所有的密切接触者与其他人隔离14天。

sentences.en: And also keeping older people, people with chronic health conditions, away from other people.
sentences.zh: 还要让老年人以及有慢性健康状况的人远离其他人。

sentences.en: So their disease modeling showed that that would only cut the death toll by about half.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们的疾病模型显示，这只能将死亡人数减少大约一半。

sentences.en: And so they also recommended these disruptive steps to really distance the entire population very much in the ways that were recommended by the White House.
sentences.zh: 所以他们还建议采取这些破坏性步骤，在很大程度上像白宫建议的那样，对整个人群进行严格的社交隔离。

sentences.en: And only those two steps together, the modelers showed, would have a very, very significant impact.
sentences.zh: 建模人员表明，只有将这两种步骤结合起来，才会产生非常非常显著的影响。

sentences.en: The other surprising thing about this report was that it wasn't talking about 15 days.
sentences.zh: 这份报告另一个令人惊讶的地方在于，它讨论的不是15天。

sentences.en: It was saying that you might need to do that intermittently at least until you had a vaccine, which we know could take 12 to 18 months.
sentences.zh: 它指出，你可能需要间歇性地这样做，至少直到你拥有疫苗为止，而我们知道这可能需要12到18个月。

sentences.en: And keep in mind their guidelines.
sentences.zh: 请记住他们的准则。

sentences.en: Nobody's forced to do this.
sentences.zh: 没有人被强迫这么做。

sentences.en: Will Americans follow them?
sentences.zh: 美国人会遵循吗？

sentences.en: How much effect will they have?
sentences.zh: 它们会产生多大的效果？

sentences.en: This all remains to be seen.
sentences.zh: 这一切都还有待观察。

sentences.en: But if measures aren't effective, there will be a surge in patients.
sentences.zh: 但如果措施没有成效，患者人数将会激增。

sentences.en: All of the models show this.
sentences.zh: 所有的模型都显示了这一点。

sentences.en: So the question is, is our health care system ready?
sentences.zh: 所以问题是，我们的医疗系统准备好了吗？

sentences.en: In many ways, we already know that we're not.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，我们其实已经知道我们没有准备好。

sentences.en: We know we don't have enough ventilators.
sentences.zh: 我们知道我们没有足够的呼吸机。

sentences.en: We don't have enough people to run those ventilators, even if we had more machines.
sentences.zh: 即使我们有更多的机器，也没有足够的人手来操作这些呼吸机。

sentences.en: So there is a need for real attention right now to expand the resources as much as possible in our health care system,
sentences.zh: 因此，现在迫切需要真正重视起来，尽可能扩大我们医疗系统中的资源，

sentences.en: substituting, conserving things that we're hearing about starting to go on so that there will be at least some more capacity
sentences.zh: 采取我们开始听到正在进行的替代和节约措施，以便至少能增加一些产能，

sentences.en: while we also hopefully take these steps as Americans to cut the transmission and slow the spread
sentences.zh: 同时我们作为美国人也希望采取这些步骤来切断传播、减缓蔓延，

sentences.en: and lessen the load on the health care system so that we don't get in a situation where doctors have to choose who gets care.
sentences.zh: 并减轻医疗系统的负荷，这样我们就不会陷入医生必须选择谁能获得治疗的境地。

sentences.en: So that's the lateSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是最新的情况。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 对不起。

sentences.en: Order.
sentences.zh: 安静。

sentences.en: I told you.
sentences.zh: 我告诉过你了。

sentences.en: Order.
sentences.zh: 肃静。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎进了一批自称改革派的人士时。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党便陷入了一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》的最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·凯尼格一起，讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在您获取播客的任何平台上收听。
